rows.note: Use 店員 for the person serving customers in a shop or market.

example.english: This clerk quickly found the right size for me.
example.traditional: 呢位店員好快就幫我搵到啱嘅尺碼。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 dim3 jyun4 hou2 faai3 zau6 bong1 ngo5 wan2 dou2 ngaam1 ge3 cek3 maa5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an office clerk handling records, accounts, correspondence, or similar work.

example.english: The office clerk has to sort through a big stack of documents today.
example.traditional: 文員今日要整理一大疊文件。
example.jyutping: man4 jyun4 gam1 jat6 jiu3 zing2 lei5 jat1 daai6 dip6 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use 酒店接待員 for a hotel employee who deals with guests, especially at reception.

example.english: The hotel clerk helped me complete the check-in process.
example.traditional: 酒店接待員幫我辦好入住手續。
example.jyutping: zau2 dim3 zip3 doi6 jyun4 bong1 ngo5 baan6 hou2 jap6 zyu6 sau2 zuk6

rows.note: Use 法律文員 for a clerk working in a legal office on legal records and related matters.

example.english: The law clerk has already organized the case files.
example.traditional: 法律文員已經整理好案件嘅文件。
example.jyutping: faat3 leot6 man4 jyun4 ji5 ging1 zing2 lei5 hou2 on3 gin6 ge3 man4 gin6
